title: Cutest Habit Tracker
body:
I immediately availed the Pro after testing it out for like 5 mins. I love this app 💘💘💘. HOWEVER… 😅 here’s a list of things I’m looking for in a habit tracker app that this app needs improvement on:

1. Dark mode
2. iPad compatibility (I want the aspect ratio to be iPad sized not iPhone sized) … maybe Mac too hahaha? 🙏
3. Sync to other devices (or maybe I just can’t find this feature in the settings?)
4. Option to write descriptions on  each habit (sometimes, I forget details)
5. WIDGETS!!! (It would add some motivation to the user if streaks can easily be seen on their home screen. Makes the app easily accessible too) 

That’s all. ✨
author: greasy's mom

title: A cute app but no widgets
body: I find the app really cute. The main reason why I won't be able to stick to it is because there are no widgets. I've tried a lot of habit apps and the ones that have stuck with me are the ones that show my streak/progress on a widget. Would probably reconsider using this again if there were useful widgets in the future!

title: Limited Habits
body: This app is kind of cute, I like the interface very much but I can only create three habits. It’s kind of expensive to buy the premium to see if I will like it.
